title: EL-to-IV: Deep Learning-Based Prediction of Photovoltaic Current-Voltage Curves from Electroluminescence Imaging
mechanism: A CNN maps a pair of EL images (20% and 80% Isc) to the full module I-V curve, and still works with one image.
adaptation: Benchmark reference row for 'power from EL'. We have one EL per cell and no I-V, so not usable as a method. Its 438 modules and bias levels match Sandia PV-IV-EL (likely the same data, unverified).
min_experiment: None for scores. For the benchmark, cite it as the image-level power baseline beside our mask-derived inactive-fraction proxy on Sandia PV-IV-EL.
evidence: R: 438 modules; validation accuracy about 95%; MPP and FF error < 2%; < 0.5 s per module.
